verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs claim live dashboards showing compliance posture, multi-framework management (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) in one place, and continuous readiness monitoring. A 'Framework Health' API page suggests per-framework health tracking, but the evidence is only marketing-level and never describes the readiness view itself. missing for 10: documented per-framework readiness percentage, explicit breakdown of passing controls vs open gaps vs remaining work, detail on how readiness is calculated, independent or hands-on corroboration.
